import os, sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
from src.exporter import export_rows
from src.csv_exporter import export_csv
from src.json_exporter import export_json
from src.dispatcher import export

rows = [{"id": 1, "name": "Zoë, \"Z\"", "extra": 9}, {"id": None}, {"name": 5}]
orig = [dict(r) for r in rows]
assert export_csv(rows) == 'id,name\n1,"Zoë, ""Z"""\n,\n,5\n'
assert export_json(rows) == '[{"id":"1","name":"Zoë, \\"Z\\""},{"id":"","name":""},{"id":"","name":"5"}]'
assert rows == orig
assert export_csv(iter(rows)) == export_rows(rows, "csv")
assert export_json(r for r in rows) == export_rows(rows, "json")
assert export_rows([], "csv") == "id,name\n" and export_rows([], "json") == "[]"
for f in ("xml", None, "CSV", []):
    try:
        export_rows([], f)
    except ValueError:
        pass
    else:
        raise AssertionError(f)
    try:
        export([], f)
    except ValueError:
        pass
    else:
        raise AssertionError(f)
print("ok")
